description:
rnews_main.rs:253 calls extract_message_id_bytes (from import/reindex.rs) to extract the Message-ID for the envelope_msgid argument passed to check_ingest. reindex.rs extract_message_id_bytes uses .lines() which does NOT handle RFC 5322 header folding (a Message-ID whose value is on a continuation line beginning with SP/HTAB). For a folded Message-ID like:

  Message-ID:\r\n <foo@example.com>\r\n

extract_message_id_bytes returns None (the field value is empty on the Message-ID: line itself), so the article is silently skipped with rejected += 1 (line 258) — it is never ingested at all. Meanwhile, check_ingest's internal extract_body_msgid DOES handle folding (ingestion.rs:119). The article is valid and carries a decodable Message-ID, but the rnews path drops it. Correct behavior: use extract_body_msgid (or a folding-aware extractor) in rnews_main instead of extract_message_id_bytes.
title: SEC0: extract_message_id_bytes ignores RFC 5322 folded Message-ID in rnews_main
